stages.next_action: Activate C1 only after the context validator passes and no economic result has been read.
stages.objective: Freeze the no-futures mandate, proxy and exact-line registries, evidence boundaries, two pre-result hypotheses and fail-closed context.
stages.pass_gate: Canonical contracts, checksums, stage graph and import boundaries pass; accepted arms and approved instruments remain empty and actionable output remains no_trade.

stages.next_action: If every source and action gate passes, build only the open development ledger; otherwise record a blocked decision without computing returns.
stages.objective: Prepartition source rows without decoding values and build a causal GBP total-return ledger from raw prices, actions and GBP/USD.
stages.pass_gate: Every required proxy, corporate action, FX observation, availability timestamp and checksum passes; locked numeric partitions are not decoded.

stages.next_action: Record both independent proxy decisions; never tune a rejected ID or promote a proxy to execution eligibility.
stages.objective: Evaluate the price-blind frozen slow-trend and turn-of-month proxy mechanisms independently with fixed controls, costs and gates.
stages.pass_gate: A mechanism passes all development and chronological validation gates at primary and stress costs; any pass remains proxy-only.

stages.next_action: Stop for explicit user approval of a bounded source pilot; do not purchase or access broker-private data automatically.
stages.objective: Qualify exact SWDA, IGLT, SGLN and AGCP London histories, actions, availability, spread, retention and cost evidence without inspecting strategy results.
stages.pass_gate: All exact lines pass identity, full-history, corporate-action, quote-unit, retention and cost gates under a lawful source contract.

stages.next_action: Preserve exact-line acceptance or rejection before any risk overlay.
stages.objective: Validate each supported proxy mechanism independently on the precommitted exact UK lines under a new frozen experiment ID.
stages.pass_gate: The unchanged economic rule passes chronological exact-line evidence, cost, uncertainty, concentration and drawdown gates.

stages.next_action: Retain every base result unchanged and reject any risk model that changes direction or rescues rejected alpha.
stages.objective: Evaluate EWMA volatility, covariance concentration and qualified liquidity controls as downward-only risk multipliers for accepted exact-line arms.
stages.pass_gate: Risk scaling improves frozen tail and risk-adjusted metrics while retaining at least ninety percent of base CAGR and never increasing exposure.

stages.next_action: Remain blocked until two economically distinct exact-line arms pass independently.
stages.objective: Compare no_trade, best single arm, static blend, risk-balanced blend and deterministic counterfactual routing using shared capital.
stages.pass_gate: At least two distinct arms pass and routing adds stable net value after costs, turnover, dependence and uncertainty while actionable output remains no_trade.

stages.next_action: Require a separate paper mandate, exact venue and written approval before any observer with broker connectivity.
stages.objective: Prospectively observe accepted exact-line arms and the shared-capital portfolio with availability, intended fills, costs, risk and decay attribution.
stages.pass_gate: The predeclared duration and opportunity minimums complete without evidence contamination, unresolved operational failure or risk-limit breach.
